discoveredComplexity: A reply's reply_to_block is read against the item the request named, never the thread's head: in an ask's thread one block id can name both a block of the comment and a part of the ask, and the two answer differently.

The dashboard, the hover card and the CLI each read a block node as its item, so the item kinds live in one exported set per surface (BLOCK_ITEM_KINDS in the web, ITEM_KINDS in the client) and a fourth kind reaches every reader.
The pull request's contract change census is in the body: four inputs answer differently than on main, with the emitter search and the stored-text statement behind the rollout line.

A type added to a shared contract reaches packages that only compile it: AskOption.id broke pi-legion's seed and claude-envoy's stricter compile of envoy-client, neither of which this change touches. Both lanes are CI jobs of their own.
